lines.en: label ayanespecial50:
scene hall_noon

School ended about an hour ago. And with Makoto now returning to class (And refusing to take a break from doing more work than everyone) I am left with nothing do to but, once again, wander the halls.
lines.zh: 学校大概一小时前就放学了。Makoto 现在已经回来上课（而且拒绝休息，干的活比谁都多），我无事可做，只好再一次在走廊里闲逛。

lines.en: My wandering is not aimless this time, though- for I’ve already decided to pay a visit to the manga club to provide some...advice. Or whatever it is an advisor is supposed to provide.
lines.zh: 不过这次我的闲逛并不是漫无目的——因为我已经决定去漫画社露个面，提供一些……建议。或者说，一个顾问本该提供的那种东西。

lines.en: Did anyone {i}ask{/i} for this advice? No. But everyone knows that people who go around providing unsolicited advice to everyone are great and awesome and definitely not annoying.
lines.zh: 有人{i}要{/i}我提建议吗？没有。可众所周知，到处给人提不请自来的建议的人，都非常棒非常厉害，绝对不烦人。

lines.en: scene black
As I begin to pull the door open, I notice a distinct lack of chatter. Meaning I am either disturbing silent reading or-
lines.zh: 我正要把门拉开，就注意到里面异常地安静。这意味着我要么打扰了默读环节，要么——

lines.en: scene ayanefitting1
Or Ayane and Molly are about to have sex.
lines.zh: 要么 Ayane 和 Molly 正准备做爱。

lines.en: I should have known something like this would happen the moment my penis was banned from being inside of her.
lines.zh: 从我的阴茎被禁止进入她身体的那一刻起，我就该料到会有这种事。

lines.en: : Hi!
: So this is how it’s going to be, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以事情就这么发展了，是吧？

lines.en: scene ayanefitting2
: How what’s going to be?
lines.zh: : 什么怎么发展了？

lines.en: : The future.
lines.zh: : 未来啊。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Anyway, what’s going on in here? Why is Molly groping you?
lines.zh: : 算了，里面这是在干什么？Molly 为什么在摸你？

lines.en: : Taking measurements, Sir. For Ayane’s Halloween costume.
lines.zh: : 在量尺寸，老师。给 Ayane 的万圣节服装。

lines.en: : That is not how you measure someone.
lines.zh: : 量尺寸不是这么量的。

lines.en: : Aye. But it is how things would work in a video game and it provides much needed fan service for when people complain about the lack of sexual content.
lines.zh: : 是。可电子游戏里就是这么运作的，而且当有人抱怨性内容太少时，这提供了亟需的福利镜头。

lines.en: : Also, Ayane’s skin is soft and touching it gives me an XP boost.
lines.zh: : 另外，Ayane 的皮肤很嫩，摸一下能让我获得经验值加成。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting3
: Moisturize daily! Remember that, guys and girls!
lines.zh: : 每天都要涂润肤乳！记住了，男生女生们！

lines.en: : I’m good. I’ve survived 31 years without ever having to do that and I do not intend to start now even {i}if{/i} it would make Molly more inclined to put her hands all over my body for a...boost thing.
lines.zh: : 我就不用了。三十一年没涂过我也活下来了，现在也不打算开始，{i}哪怕{/i}涂了会让 Molly 更愿意为了那个……加成什么的把手伸遍我全身。

lines.en: : No, Sir. If I laid hands on you only to find that your skin rivaled Ayane’s in terms of softness, the only status effect I’d receive would be confusion. And I have already hurt myself enough for the next year, thank you.
lines.zh: : 不，老师。要是我把手放上去，却发现您的皮肤嫩得能跟 Ayane 一较高下，我获得的唯一状态效果只会是混乱。而且我今年已经把自己伤得够多了，谢谢。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting4
: Aren’t you proud of me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你不为我骄傲吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : For what? Having a tryst with a small, Irish girl on school grounds?
lines.zh: : 骄傲什么？在校园里跟一个爱尔兰小姑娘幽会？

lines.en: : No. For keeping my body in tip-top shape so we’ll be able to go fifty rounds on the night of our wedding.
lines.zh: : 不是。是为了我把身体保养得这么好，这样我们婚礼那晚才能大战五十回合。

lines.en: Is {i}that{/i} how Chika does it? Moisturizing?
lines.zh: Chika 就是{i}这么{/i}做的吗？涂润肤乳？

lines.en: Maybe I {i}should{/i} start doing that if it yields those sorts of benefits.
lines.zh: 要是能有那种好处，也许我也{i}该{/i}开始涂了。

lines.en: : Sure, whatever. I’m proud.
lines.zh: : 行吧，随便。我骄傲。

lines.en: : I’ll bet. You haven’t taken your eyes off of me this entire time.
lines.zh: : 我看也是。你从头到尾眼睛就没离开过我。

lines.en: : Why would I? Fanservice is cool.
lines.zh: : 为什么要移开？福利镜头很棒啊。

lines.en: : Arms up.
lines.zh: : 抬手。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting5
: Yes, ma’am.
lines.zh: : 是，长官。

lines.en: : Correction- fanservice is {i}very{/i} cool.
lines.zh: : 更正一下——福利镜头{i}非常{/i}棒。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: These feel bigger than I remember them.
lines.zh: : 感觉比我记得的更大了。

lines.en: : When was the last time you grabbed them?
lines.zh: : 你上一次抓是什么时候？

lines.en: : Last Halloween, I believe.
lines.zh: : 我记得是去年万圣节。

lines.en: : Don’t you think it’s weird that there have been multiple Halloweens in our first year of-
lines.zh: : 你不觉得我们一年级就过了好几个万圣节，很奇怪吗——

lines.en: scene ayanefitting6
: What do you think, Sir? Want to give ‘em a grab and see how they compare to your memory? Assuming you’re not already providing every day checks for Ayane, that is.
lines.zh: : 您觉得呢，老师？要上手抓一把，看看跟您记忆里的比怎么样吗？当然，前提是您没有每天都替 Ayane 做检查。

lines.en: : Ahh, those were the days.
lines.zh: : 啊，那些日子一去不返了。

lines.en: : Go ahead, Sensei. I don’t mind.
lines.zh: : 来吧，Sensei。我不介意。

lines.en: : I’m going to refrain from groping you in front of your classmates for now, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我暂时还是不要在同学面前摸你了，Ayane。

lines.en: : Is it even groping if it is for the sake of fashion, Sir?
lines.zh: : 如果是为了时尚，那还算摸吗，老师？

lines.en: : I’m sure that would sound great in court. Thanks, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定这话在法庭上听起来一定很棒。谢了，Molly。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting7
: ‘Tis no trouble at all, Sir. I’m simply doing my job as club president.
lines.zh: : 一点都不麻烦，老师。我只是在履行社长的职责。

lines.en: : I understand now why you wanted the role.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白你为什么想要这个职位了。

lines.en: : Sir, I’ve touched so many boobs at this point that I may as well be immune to them.
lines.zh: : 老师，我到现在已经摸过那么多胸部，差不多都免疫了。

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel offended by that.
lines.zh: : 这话让我忍不住觉得被冒犯了。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting8
: Don’t be. Yours are consistently the most enjoyable to grab. I mean measure. Which is what I’m doing. Measuring them.
lines.zh: : 别这样。你的始终是最让人愉快的抓握对象。我是说测量。我现在就是在测量。测量它们。

lines.en: : I think Molly’s just a pervert.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Molly 就是个变态。

lines.en: : She is. But as long as she gets my costume right, I don’t really care about how incorrect her methods are.
lines.zh: : 她就是。不过只要她能把我的衣服做对，她的方法有多不正确我都不在乎。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting9
: Worry not, Lidearel. I can assure you our group cosplay for this year’s Halloween party will be both my best work yet {i}and{/i} brimming with full-on lesbian energy.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Lidearel。我可以保证，我们今年万圣节派对的团体 cosplay 会是我最出色的作品，{i}而且{/i}洋溢着满满的百合能量。

lines.en: : I once again remain adamant that Halloween is the best holiday.
lines.zh: : 我再次坚持认为，万圣节是最棒的节日。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure how much lesbian energy I can handle between the costumes and this club room.
lines.zh: : 我真的不确定，光是这些服装加上这间社团教室，我能承受多少百合能量。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting10
: Ahh. Is {i}that{/i} why you sided with those normie athletes instead of your companions in the manga club? Because of the amount of yuri power?
lines.zh: : 啊。{i}所以{/i}你才站到那群现充运动员那边，而不是漫画社的伙伴这边？因为百合之力太强了？

lines.en: : Noooo...I just like swimming and staying active.
lines.zh: : 才不呢……我只是喜欢游泳，喜欢保持活力。

lines.en: : And using us for your own benefit when the time comes to look cute.
lines.zh: : 还有在需要扮可爱的时候利用我们。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting11
: Joke’s on you, Molly. I always look cute. Plus, I have the perfect boobs according to whatever metric you use to rate them.
lines.zh: : 你失算了，Molly。我一直都很可爱。再说，不管你用什么标准打分，我的胸部都是完美的。

lines.en: : They certainly are nice.
lines.zh: : 它们确实很棒。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei. I am glad we’ve reached the point where you are able to compliment them in front of my friends.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Sensei。我真高兴我们已经到了你能在我的朋友面前夸它们的地步。

lines.en: : It’s just Molly. She’s not going to do anything.
lines.zh: : 就 Molly 一个而已。她又不会干什么。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting12
: Oi! What’s with this “Just Molly” crap? Shouldn’t ye’ be holdin’ me to the same standard everybody else is kept at?
lines.zh: : 喂！这“就 Molly 一个”是什么鬼话？您难道不该拿跟其他人一样的标准来要求我吗？

lines.en: : Not when you’re even more of a degenerate than I am.
lines.zh: : 在你比我还要堕落的情况下，不用。

lines.en: : Nobody is more of a degenerate than you, Sir.
lines.zh: : 没有人比您更堕落，老师。

lines.en: : How many cartoons have you masturbated to now?
lines.zh: : 你到现在对着多少部动画片打过飞机了？

lines.en: scene ayanefitting13
: Like...ever? Or...within a certain timeframe?
lines.zh: : 是问……有史以来？还是……某个时间段内？

lines.en: : It’s a weird day when I am somehow the least sexually charged person in the room.
lines.zh: : 我居然成了这个房间里性欲最淡的人，今天真是奇怪的一天。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting14
: Either way, we’re done for now. I got what I needed, so you can go ahead and put your clothes back on. Your {i}normie{/i} club is waiting for you, after all.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，今天就到这儿吧。我要的都拿到了，你可以把衣服穿回去了。毕竟你的{i}现充{/i}社团还在等你。

lines.en: : My normie club is taking the day off since Imani and Karin both had stuff to do today. But if you two wanted to come over to the pool and do a little swimming, I’m sure I can get us in.
lines.zh: : 我的现充社团今天放假，因为 Imani 和 Karin 都有事。不过要是你们俩想去泳池游个泳，我肯定能带我们进去。

lines.en: : Me? Swimming? Have you gone mad?
lines.zh: : 我？游泳？你疯了吗？

lines.en: : I would have agreed to come and watch if it was going to be both of you. But I can’t say I’m fond of the idea of just watching you swim by yourself. That sounds both extremely creepy and extremely lonely.
lines.zh: : 如果是你们俩一起，我本来会答应去看的。但我实在不怎么喜欢光看着你一个人游泳这个主意。那听起来既变态到了极点，又寂寞到了极点。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting15
: You guys are no fun. Is it really too much to ask to be covered in spandex and soaking wet with my teacher and an exchange student?
lines.zh: : 你们真没劲。穿着氨纶泳衣、浑身湿透地和我的老师还有一名交换生待在一起，这个要求真的很过分吗？

lines.en: : When you put it that way, probably.
lines.zh: : 被你这么一说，大概是挺过分的。

lines.en: : Besides, I’ve got a batch of quests I need to be turnin’ in anyway. You two’ll be alone from here on out as Molly MacCormack is logging off.
lines.zh: : 再说，我还有一批任务要交呢。你们俩从现在起就独处吧，Molly MacCormack 要下线了。

lines.en: : But how are you going to turn your quests in if you-
lines.zh: : 可是你要怎么交任务，如果你——

lines.en: : They’re in a different game, obviously.
lines.zh: : 它们在另一个游戏里，显而易见。

lines.en: scene black
: Farewell! And don’t forget to lock the door when you leave! There are collector's items in here!
lines.zh: : 告辞！走的时候别忘了锁门！这里面可都是收藏品！

lines.en: Molly exits the clubroom and I am, for probably the first time ever, the sole person inside who is actually {i}affiliated{/i} with it in some way.
lines.zh: Molly 走出社团教室，我有生以来大概是第一次成了屋里唯一一个跟这个社团多少{i}有点关系{/i}的人。

lines.en: Granted, this affiliation is still pretty new to me and I have no idea what it even entails, but still.
lines.zh: 当然，这层关系对我来说还很新，我甚至不知道它意味着什么，但尽管如此。

lines.en: Anyway, Ayane non-chalantly puts her clothes back on like I’ve watched her do a thousand times before and then slides a couple of chairs out from underneath the table for us to sit down on.
lines.zh: 总之，Ayane 漫不经心地穿回衣服，就像我以前看过上千次那样，然后从桌子底下拽出两把椅子让我们坐下。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting16
: So, how excited are you to see my costume on a scale of one to ten?
lines.zh: : 那么，想看我的服装，你有多期待？一到十分打个分？

lines.en: : One being your suit of armor and ten being you...wearing absolutely nothing?
lines.zh: : 一分是你的那身铠甲，十分是你……什么都不穿？

lines.en: scene ayanefitting17
: Leave my armor alone. I looked gallant and beautiful and strong and-
lines.zh: : 别提我的铠甲。我当时英姿飒爽、美丽又强壮，而且——

lines.en: : And zero fuckable.
lines.zh: : 而且一点都不想让人操。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting18
: I’m zero fuckable now and you’re still spending time with me.
lines.zh: : 我现在一点都不想让人操，你不还是陪着我。

lines.en: : Good point. See you later, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 说得好。回头见，Ayane。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. Very funny.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈。真好笑。

lines.en: : I think you’ll like this one, though. I’ll still be gallant and elegant, but I’ll be the type of gallant and elegant that you’ll want to ejaculate in.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得你会喜欢这一件。我依然会英姿飒爽、优雅动人，但会是那种让你想把精液射在里面的英姿飒爽和优雅动人。

lines.en: : Halloween can’t come soon enough.
lines.zh: : 万圣节真是越快到越好。

lines.en: : I’m not sure how I feel about having two parties in such quick succession, though. What with everyone talking about the Dorm Wars making a return and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 不过我拿不准连着办两场派对是什么感觉。毕竟大家都在说宿舍大战要回归了什么的。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting19
: Oh, has nobody told you yet? We’re combining them this year to save time. Especially since we still have both our annual beach trip {i}and{/i} Christmas party right around the corner as well.
lines.zh: : 哦，还没人告诉你吗？今年我们把它们合并了，好省点时间。尤其是我们一年一度的海边旅行{i}和{/i}圣诞派对也都近在眼前了。

lines.en: : Time can sure get pretty fucky because of this reset business, huh? I don’t remember ever feeling this...rushed before.
lines.zh: : 因为重置这档子事，时间真是乱七八糟，是吧？我不记得自己以前有过这种……被时间追着跑的感觉。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not like anything is going anywhere. We don’t have to rush if combining everything seems like it’s going to be stressful to plan since I know you like being involved in that sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，又没有什么东西会跑掉。要是把所有事都合并起来让你筹划起来压力太大，我们也不必着急——我知道你喜欢参与这类事情。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting20
: Nah...I’m sure it’ll be fine. We’ll just have to figure out the new contests as soon as possible since I’m pretty sure we’ll be changing most of them.
lines.zh: : 不……我肯定没问题的。我们只要尽快定下新的比赛项目就行，因为我敢说大部分都要换掉。

lines.en: : Match-ups too since losing to the same person two years in a row would probably make all of us feel like shit.
lines.zh: : 对战分组也要换，毕竟连着两年输给同一个人，我们大概都会很难受。

lines.en: : Not out for ruthless...rap....revenge or whatever?
lines.zh: : 不打算来一场无情的……rap……复仇什么的？

lines.en: scene ayanefitting21
: Probably not. There’s no way I can compete with Uta without some serious training. And with the exception of Kirin, nobody is really looking for revenge on anyone.
lines.zh: : 大概不会。没有认真训练，我根本比不过 Uta。而且除了 Kirin，也没人真的想找谁报仇。

lines.en: : In fact, both Maya and Makoto were extremely adamant about {i}not{/i} repeating the same contest two years in a row. Though, Makoto might still just be feeling kind of down.
lines.zh: : 事实上，Maya 和 Makoto 都极其坚决地{i}反对{/i}连着两年办同一个项目。不过 Makoto 可能只是心情还有点低落。

lines.en: : Anything you have your eye on, then? Anyone you’re looking to take down?
lines.zh: : 那你有看中什么吗？有想击败的人吗？

lines.en: scene ayanefitting20
: Not off the top of my head. I’m sure something will come to me, though.
lines.zh: : 一时半会儿想不出来。不过我肯定会有主意的。

lines.en: : Or, who knows? Maybe not. Finding motivation at all lately has been damn near impossible. That’s why I’m hoping this party can get me back into the swing of things.
lines.zh: : 或者，谁知道呢？也许想不出来。最近我几乎完全找不到动力。所以我才希望这场派对能让我重新找回状态。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’m not going to talk your ear off again with more of my apocalyptic worries. I’ve been battering you with them pretty much every time we’ve talked lately and I don’t think either of us likes it.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我不会再拿那些末日忧虑对你唠叨个没完了。最近我们每次聊天我都在拿这些轰炸你，我觉得我们俩都不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting16
: I might ask you for a reward if I {i}do{/i} win, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我要是{i}赢了{/i}，可能会向你讨个奖励。

lines.en: : A reward? What kind of reward?
lines.zh: : 奖励？什么奖励？

lines.en: : A date, maybe?
lines.zh: : 一次约会，也许？

lines.en: : We’ve been on dates before, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们以前也约会过吧？

lines.en: : I guess. Maybe some sort of promise, then? Or...maybe a memento of yours that I can hang onto for good luck? I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。那也许是某种承诺？或者……也许是你的某样纪念品，让我留着讨个好运？我也不太确定。

lines.en: : But I kind of need something to latch onto right now since latching onto the whole idea of the world being one big cycle isn’t good for me and you’re only a viable distraction when I can actually see you.
lines.zh: : 但我现在需要抓住点什么，因为“整个世界就是一个大循环”这种想法对我没好处，而你只有在我真的看得见你的时候，才算是个有效的分心物。

lines.en: : If there’s some sort of reward for me if I come out on top of my dorm war thingy...I feel like I’ll be able to look forward to it a little bit more. The issue is just figuring out what the reward should {i}be.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果我在宿舍大战里拿到第一就能有某种奖励……我觉得自己会更有盼头一些。问题只在于想清楚那个奖励该{i}是{/i}什么。

lines.en: : Well, what do you want it to be?
lines.zh: : 那么，你想要它是什么？

lines.en: : Maybe an engagement ring?
lines.zh: : 也许一枚订婚戒指？

lines.en: : Uh-huh. Anything else you had in mind?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。还有别的想法吗？

lines.en: scene ayanefitting21
: A...promise ring?
lines.zh: : 一个……约定戒指？

lines.en: : Isn’t that just an engagement ring for someone who’s too much of a pussy to actually propose?
lines.zh: : 那不就是给那些怂得不敢真的求婚的人准备的订婚戒指吗？

lines.en: : Well, it obviously has to be something involving you since that’s pretty much the only thing getting me out of bed at this point.
lines.zh: : 嗯，它显然得是跟你有关的东西，因为眼下这差不多是唯一能让我从床上爬起来的东西了。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting19
: Oh! What if you be my slave for a day?
lines.zh: : 哦！要不你给我当一天奴隶？

lines.en: : Are you into BDSM now? Because, if so, I think you’ve been spending too much time with Osako.
lines.zh: : 你现在迷上 BDSM 了？如果是，我觉得你跟 Osako 待太久了。

lines.en: : Are the rumors about Miss Watabe and Miss Osaka actually true?
lines.zh: : 关于 Watabe 小姐和 Osaka 小姐的传闻是真的吗？

lines.en: : Where did those rumors even come from?
lines.zh: : 那些传闻到底是从哪儿来的？

lines.en: : One of the girls in Class D works in the entertainment district and said she saw the two of them going into a love hotel carrying a pair of handcuffs.
lines.zh: : D 班有个女生在娱乐区打工，说她看见她们两个拿着一副手铐进了一家情人酒店。

lines.en: : Maybe Osako just...fights crime?
lines.zh: : 也许 Osako 只是……在打击犯罪？

lines.en: : And Miss Watabe is her sidekick?
lines.zh: : 而 Watabe 小姐是她的助手？

lines.en: : Seems plausible to me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得挺合理的。

lines.en: : Or one of them was handcuffed to the bedpost and consensually abused for the next several hours.
lines.zh: : 或者她们其中一个被铐在床柱上，在接下来的几个小时里被自愿地狠狠折腾。

lines.en: : That sounds more accurate.
lines.zh: : 这个听起来更准确。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting20
: Anyway, there is {i}one{/i} thing I want from you. I’m just not sure if it’s something I want for my own peace of mind or if...
lines.zh: : 总之，我想要你给我{i}一样{/i}东西。我只是不确定，那是为了我自己心安，还是……

lines.en: : If it’s something I want because I think it might make things a little bit easier for us.
lines.zh: : 还是因为我觉得它能让我们稍微轻松一点，才想要的。

lines.en: : That’s...
: I’m not really sure how to interpret that, actually.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我真不知道该怎么理解。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting21
: That’s not your fault. I didn’t really know how to {i}say{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 这不是你的错。我自己也{i}说{/i}不清楚。

lines.en: : How about this, then...if I win my contest this year...you can reward me by...
lines.zh: : 那这样吧……如果今年我赢了比赛……你就奖励我……

lines.en: scene ayanefitting22

lines.zh: : 就是……

lines.en: : Answering a question.
lines.zh: : 回答我一个问题。

lines.en: : That’s it?
lines.zh: : 就这样？

lines.en: : It’s a multi-layered and complicated question that could wind up changing everything, though. So I reserve the right to change my mind if I get scared and want to back down.
lines.zh: : 不过那是一个层次很多又很复杂的问题，说不定会改变一切。所以我保留反悔的权利，万一我害怕了想退缩呢。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to know the question ahead of time?
lines.zh: : 我可以提前知道那个问题吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. You’ll find out if I win.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。要是我赢了，你就知道了。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: : I’ve got a question of my own then. Why ask {i}anything{/i} with that much potential for change? I figured you’d...want to avoid that, if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 那我也有个问题。为{i}什么{/i}要问一个可能带来那么大改变的问题？我以为你会……只要有可能就避开这种事。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting23
: Because everything {i}else{/i} is already changing.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}其他{/i}一切都已经在变了。

lines.en: : I figure slipping this question in might make it a little easier for me to adapt if I don’t like the answer.
lines.zh: : 我想，趁现在把这个问题塞进去，万一我不喜欢那个答案，也许能让我更容易接受一点。

lines.en: : Not {i}everything{/i} is changing, though. We might not be able to have sex at the moment, but that doesn’t mean I don’t still-
lines.zh: : 可并不是{i}一切{/i}都在变。我们眼下也许做不了爱，但这不代表我就没有——

lines.en: : You love me and I love you. {i}That{/i} much hasn’t changed. But “everything” rarely means {i}everything{/i}.
lines.zh: : 你爱我，我也爱你。{i}这一点{/i}没变。可“一切”这个词很少真的意味着{i}一切{/i}。

lines.en: : What it means in this context is that {i}I’m{/i} changing...
lines.zh: : 在这里它意味着，{i}我{/i}正在改变……

lines.en: : Cracking under pressure...
lines.zh: : 在压力之下裂开……

lines.en: : But most importantly...
lines.zh: : 但最重要的是……

lines.en: scene ayanefitting24
: It means I’ve accepted that I’ve gotta grow up a little sooner than I wanted to.
lines.zh: : 它意味着我已经接受了，我得比自己希望的时间更早一点长大。

lines.en: : It sucks, really. I like being a kid.
lines.zh: : 说实话这很糟。我喜欢当小孩。

lines.en: : But I literally {i}can’t{/i} be a kid anymore if I want to maintain the life I have now. {i}Not{/i} changing and just going with the flow the way you do in the face of the end of days, is...
lines.zh: : 可如果我想保住现在的生活，我就真的{i}不能{/i}再当小孩了。像你那样{i}不变{/i}、在世界末日面前随波逐流，是……

lines.en: : That wouldn’t work for me.
lines.zh: : 那对我不起作用。

lines.en: scene ayanefitting16
: I think I understand why Maya is the way she is now.
lines.zh: : 我想我明白 Maya 为什么变成现在这样了。

lines.en: : And since I already promised I wouldn’t talk your ear off again, I’ll keep this as brief as I can.
lines.zh: : 而且既然我已经答应过不再对你唠叨，我就尽量简短。

lines.en: : I {i}absolutely...{/i}
: {i}Vehemently...{/i}
: Refuse to lose you.
lines.zh: : 拒绝失去你。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: scene ayanefitting25
Ayane shows no intention of letting me finish my sentence by leaping into my arms before I’m able to get the second word out.
lines.zh: Ayane 丝毫没有让我把话说完的意思，我还没吐出第二个字，她就扑进了我的怀里。

lines.en: And I guess I’m glad she does as...I have no idea what that second word was even going to be.
lines.zh: 而且我大概还挺庆幸她这么做的，因为……我根本不知道那第二个字本来会是什么。

lines.en: If it were up to me to decide her fate and whether or not she ever {i}will{/i} lose me, of course I’d make it so she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 如果她的命运、她{i}会不会{/i}失去我，都由我来决定，我当然会让她永远不会。

lines.en: But the sad truth is I have no power over that.
lines.zh: 可悲哀的事实是，我对此无能为力。

lines.en: And neither does she.
lines.zh: 她也一样。

lines.en: But if growing up ahead of schedule is her way of combating that-
lines.zh: 但如果提前长大是她对抗这件事的方式——

lines.en: If sacrificing the remainder of her youth is the weapon she needs to slaughter it-
lines.zh: 如果牺牲掉剩余的青春是她用来斩杀它的武器——

lines.en: I will be the sheath to her sword.
lines.zh: 那我就做她那把剑的剑鞘。

lines.en: scene black
Or the grass the blood that coats it falls on.
lines.zh: 或者是那剑上鲜血滴落的草地。
